tools.name: list_my_tours
tools.description: List the tours the authenticated user belongs to. Call this first when the user hasn't said which tour they mean, or when they ask something like "which tours am I on". Every other tool needs a tourId, which comes from this list.

tools.name: get_next_event
tools.description: Get the next upcoming event on a tour (e.g. "what's the next show"). Optionally filter to one event type (show, travel, day_off, load_in, sound_check, rehearsal, meeting, other) and/or return more than one upcoming event.

tools.name: get_day_sheet
tools.description: Build a day sheet for one date on a tour: every event that day, in order, formatted as plain text ready to paste into a crew text thread or email. Defaults to today (UTC) if no date is given.

tools.name: list_open_items
tools.description: Check what needs attention on a tour: unconfirmed events, optionally scoped to one date. Mirrors the "needs confirmation" list in the TourPro app.

tools.name: ask_tourpro
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question about a tour (schedule, team, permissions, hotels, travel, or documents). This calls TourPro's existing grounded Q&A: it only answers from real tour data and cites its sources, and declines out-of-scope questions rather than guessing. Max 600 characters.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List every event on a tour (optionally within a date range) INCLUDING each event's id. Use this to find the eventId needed by update_event, delete_event, and confirm_event.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Add an event (show, travel, day_off, load_in, sound_check, rehearsal, meeting, other) to a tour's schedule. Requires the can_create_events permission. Times are 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. 7pm = "19:00").

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Change fields on an existing event. Only the fields you pass are changed. Get the eventId from list_events. Requires the can_edit_schedule permission.

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Permanently delete an event from a tour. Destructive: only call after the user has clearly asked to delete that specific event, and set confirm to true. Requires the can_delete_events permission.

tools.name: confirm_event
tools.description: Mark an event confirmed or unconfirmed. Requires schedule-edit permission.

tools.name: create_tour
tools.description: Create a new tour. The caller becomes its owner. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; default_timezone is an optional IANA name.

tools.name: update_tour
tools.description: Edit a tour's name, description, dates, or default timezone. Only the fields you pass change. Requires can_edit_tour.

tools.name: delete_tour
tools.description: Permanently delete an entire tour and its schedule. Highly destructive: only call after the user has explicitly asked to delete that exact tour, and set confirm to true. Requires can_delete_tour.

tools.name: list_day_notes
tools.description: List day notes on a tour (optionally one date), including each note's id.

tools.name: create_day_note
tools.description: Add a note to a tour day. Requires schedule-edit permission.

tools.name: update_day_note
tools.description: Edit a day note's title or body. Get the noteId and version from list_day_notes and pass the version as expectedVersion, so an edit someone else saved in the meantime is not silently overwritten.

tools.name: delete_day_note
tools.description: Delete a day note. Destructive: only call after the user asked to delete it, and set confirm to true.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List local contacts (venue, hotel, promoter, local crew) for a tour, or for one date. Includes contact ids.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Add a contact to a tour day. type is one of venue, hotel, promoter, local, other. Requires schedule-edit permission.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Change a contact. Only the fields you pass change. Get contactId from list_contacts.

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Permanently delete a contact. Only after the user asked for it; set confirm to true.

tools.name: list_hotels
tools.description: List hotels/accommodation for a tour, or for one date, with hotel ids.

tools.name: create_hotel
tools.description: Add a hotel stay to a tour day. Requires the accommodation-edit permission.

tools.name: update_hotel
tools.description: Change a hotel. Only the fields you pass change. Get hotelId from list_hotels.

tools.name: delete_hotel
tools.description: Permanently delete a hotel stay. Only after the user asked for it; set confirm to true.

tools.name: list_guest_list
tools.description: List guest-list entries for a tour, optionally for one date, with entry ids, approval status, pass_type, and the is_late flag for requests submitted after the cutoff.

tools.name: add_guest
tools.description: Add a guest to a tour's guest list (status starts as requested). Requires guest-list-edit permission.

tools.name: update_guest
tools.description: Change a guest-list entry. Only the fields you pass change. Get entryId from list_guest_list.

tools.name: set_guest_status
tools.description: Approve or deny a guest-list entry. Requires the approve-guests permission.

tools.name: delete_guest
tools.description: Remove a guest-list entry. Only after the user asked for it; set confirm to true.

tools.name: list_advances
tools.description: List advances (venue advance forms) for a tour, optionally for one date, with ids and status.

tools.name: get_advance
tools.description: Get one advance with all of its fields and filled-in values.

tools.name: create_advance
tools.description: Create an advance for a tour day. fields defines the form; field_values holds the answers. Requires schedule-edit permission.

tools.name: update_advance
tools.description: Change an advance: title, status (not_started, in_progress, done), fields, or filled-in values.

tools.name: delete_advance
tools.description: Permanently delete an advance. Only after the user asked for it; set confirm to true.

tools.name: list_tour_members
tools.description: List the people on a tour with their user ids and roles. Use it to find the user_id for passenger and hotel-guest tools.

tools.name: list_invitations
tools.description: List a tour's pending and past invitations with ids. Requires the invite-members permission.

tools.name: invite_member
tools.description: Email an invitation to join a tour with a role. Sends a real email, so only call when the user asked to invite that person. Venue-role invites are not supported here.

tools.name: resend_invitation
tools.description: Resend a pending invitation email. Get invitationId from list_invitations.

tools.name: revoke_invitation
tools.description: Cancel a pending invitation. Only after the user asked for it; set confirm to true.

tools.name: list_flight_passengers
tools.description: List who is on a travel event (flight), with passenger ids. Needs the can_view_travel permission.

tools.name: add_flight_passenger
tools.description: Put a tour member on a travel event. user_id comes from list_tour_members. Needs can_edit_travel.

tools.name: update_flight_passenger
tools.description: Change a passenger's seat, requests or notes. Get passengerId from list_flight_passengers.

tools.name: remove_flight_passenger
tools.description: Take a passenger off a travel event. Only after the user asked for it; set confirm to true.

tools.name: list_hotel_guests
tools.description: List who is booked into a hotel stay, with guest ids. Get hotelId from list_hotels.

tools.name: add_hotel_guest
tools.description: Book a tour member into a hotel stay. user_id comes from list_tour_members. Needs accommodation-edit permission.

tools.name: update_hotel_guest
tools.description: Change a hotel guest's dates, room type, confirmation number or notes.

tools.name: remove_hotel_guest
tools.description: Take a guest off a hotel stay. Only after the user asked for it; set confirm to true.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List a tour's documents (contracts, riders, itineraries) with ids, titles and tags.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get one document's details.

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Change a document's title, description, tags, or link it to a day or event. Does not replace the file.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Permanently delete a document and its file. Only after the user asked for it; set confirm to true.

tools.name: list_day_sheet_templates
tools.description: List a tour's day sheet templates with ids.

tools.name: create_day_sheet_template
tools.description: Create a day sheet template. sections follows the shape returned by list_day_sheet_templates.

tools.name: update_day_sheet_template
tools.description: Change a day sheet template's name, sections, meta, or active flag.

tools.name: delete_day_sheet_template
tools.description: Permanently delete a day sheet template. Only after the user asked for it; set confirm to true.

tools.name: list_schedule_templates
tools.description: List your saved schedule templates (a day's events saved for reuse), with ids.

tools.name: create_schedule_template
tools.description: Save one tour date's events as a reusable schedule template.

tools.name: rename_schedule_template
tools.description: Rename a saved schedule template.

tools.name: delete_schedule_template
tools.description: Permanently delete a saved schedule template. Only after the user asked for it; set confirm to true.

tools.name: apply_schedule_template
tools.description: Add a saved schedule template's events to a tour date. Adds events only; it never replaces or deletes existing ones.

tools.name: list_crew_templates
tools.description: List your crew templates (read-only; applying them would invite people, so it is not exposed).

tools.name: list_event_reminders
tools.description: List the reminders set on an event, with reminder ids.

tools.name: list_upcoming_reminders
tools.description: List reminders that are due soon across a tour.

tools.name: create_event_reminder
tools.description: Add a reminder to an event, e.g. 30 minutes before. Requires schedule-edit permission. Reminders notify real people, so only set recipients the user asked for.

tools.name: update_event_reminder
tools.description: Change a reminder. Only the fields you pass change. Get reminderId from list_event_reminders.

tools.name: delete_event_reminder
tools.description: Delete a reminder. Only after the user asked for it; set confirm to true.

tools.name: get_event_visibility
tools.description: See who can view an event (everyone, certain roles, or chosen people).

tools.name: set_event_visibility
tools.description: Limit who can see an event, or open it to everyone. Hiding an event from people changes what they see in the app, so only do it when the user asked.

tools.name: get_my_privacy_preferences
tools.description: Read the signed-in user's analytics and marketing consent choices. Read-only: consent can only be changed by the user in the app.

tools.name: list_my_notifications
tools.description: List the signed-in user's notifications, optionally for one tour.

tools.name: mark_notification_read
tools.description: Mark one of the user's notifications as read.

tools.name: list_sent_notifications
tools.description: See the history of push notifications sent to a tour. Sending notifications is not exposed.

tools.name: get_tour_activity
tools.description: Read a tour's recent activity log: who changed what, and when.

tools.name: list_settlements
tools.description: List the show settlements on a tour with status, total payable and balance due, including each settlement id. Requires the View finance permission.

tools.name: get_settlement
tools.description: Read one settlement as a statement summary: deal, gross, NBOR, expenses, NAE, earnings, total payable, payments, balance due and status, plus the draft calculation and its digest when a draft exists. Requires View finance.

tools.name: list_settlement_payments
tools.description: List the payment ledger of a settlement (deposits, payments, withholding credits, write-offs, refunds) with each entry id, plus the balance due. Requires View finance.

tools.name: create_settlement
tools.description: Start a settlement draft for a show event (an event of type show; see list_events). Optional deal and box office fields fill the draft right away; the rest can be set later with update_settlement_draft. Requires Manage finance.

tools.name: update_settlement_draft
tools.description: Change a settlement draft: deal type, guarantee, percentage and base, gross or ticket tiers, deductions, expenses, expense cap, promoter. Only the fields you pass change; list fields replace the whole list. Adjustments, chargebacks, tax on fee and reimbursements are kept as they are (edit those in t

tools.name: finalize_settlement
tools.description: Finalize a settlement draft into a published revision, in two steps. First call without calculationDigest: nothing changes and the tool returns the server-computed result, its calculationDigest and rowVersion. Show that result to the user. Only after they confirm, call again with that calculationDig

tools.name: record_settlement_payment
tools.description: Record a ledger entry on a settlement: deposit, payment, withholding_credit, write_off or refund_to_promoter. Cash kinds (deposit, payment, refund_to_promoter) need heldBy; non-cash kinds need notes giving the reason. Entries are permanent (void them instead of deleting). Requires Manage finance.

tools.name: void_settlement_payment
tools.description: Void a ledger entry on a settlement (it stays in history and counts for nothing). Only after the user asked for it; set confirm to true and give a reason. Requires Manage finance.

tools.name: get_tour_budget
tools.description: Read the tour budget: totals per currency (planned, earned, recorded cost, forecast at completion), the consolidated total in the reporting currency when exchange rates allow, and each budget line with planned, actual, remaining and forecast amounts and its id. Requires View finance and tour-wide ac

tools.name: list_tour_expenses
tools.description: List the tour's budget expenses (manual and imported receipts), optionally within a date range, with each expense id and rowVersion. Requires View finance and tour-wide access.

tools.name: create_tour_expense
tools.description: Record a paid or settled manual expense (or refund) on the tour budget. Requires Manage finance and tour-wide access.

tools.name: update_tour_expense
tools.description: Change an expense. Only the fields you pass change. Imported receipts keep their imported date, merchant, amount and currency; only category, show, funding, payer and notes can change. Get expenseId and rowVersion from list_tour_expenses. Requires Manage finance and tour-wide access.

tools.name: update_budget_line_remaining
tools.description: Set how much is still expected on a budget line (expected remaining), which drives its forecast, or clear it with null so TourPro suggests planned minus actual again. The amount is in the line's own currency. Get lineId and rowVersion from get_tour_budget. Requires Manage finance and tour-wide acces

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "update_day_note" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_day_sheet, resend_invitation, list_my_notifications, mark_notification_read, list_sent_notifications, update_settlement_draft · Private data: ask_tourpro, list_contacts, create_contact, update_contact, delete_contact, list_documents, get_document, update_document, delete_document, record_settlement_payment, create_tour_expense · Public sink: get_day_sheet, invite_member, resend_invitation, create_event_reminder · Destructive: delete_event, delete_tour, delete_day_note, delete_contact, delete_hotel, delete_guest, delete_advance, remove_flight_passenger, remove_hotel_guest, delete_document, delete_day_sheet_template, delete_schedule_template, delete_event_reminder.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_day_sheet, resend_invitation, list_my_notifications, mark_notification_read, list_sent_notifications, update_settlement_draft · Private data: ask_tourpro, list_contacts, create_contact, update_contact, delete_contact, list_documents, get_document, update_document, delete_document, record_settlement_payment, create_tour_expense · Public sink: get_day_sheet, invite_member, resend_invitation, create_event_reminder · Destructive: delete_event, delete_tour, delete_day_note, delete_contact, delete_hotel, delete_guest, delete_advance, remove_flight_passenger, remove_hotel_guest, delete_document, delete_day_sheet_template, delete_schedule_template, delete_event_reminder

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
